name: whois-mcp-server
description: Look up domain registration, check registry record status, fetch DNS records, and resolve IPs and ASNs over RDAP and DNS-over-HTTPS via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Look up domain registration, check registry record status, fetch DNS records, and resolve IPs and ASNs over RDAP and DNS-over-HTTPS via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Six RDAP and DNS-over-HTTPS tools: whois_lookup_domain (registry record and optional registrar contact detail), whois_check_availability (registered/not_found/unknown record status; no registration eligibility guarantee), whois_get_dns (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA, PTR, SRV, DS, DNSKEY, TLSA, HTTPS), whois_lookup_ip (netblock CIDRs, org, abuse contact, registration dates, PTR outcome), whois_lookup_asn (organization, abuse contact, registration dates and RIR), and whois_get_dossier (hostname DNS with explicitly attributed registration data). Domain tools accept Unicode names and return ASCII lookup names with decoded Unicode display. No API keys required. Runs over stdio or Streamable HTTP.
